note: Adapted from Emerson’s 1952 original English description; measurements translated verbatim from Table 16 of the original, in millimetres, listed separately for the two localities. The original did not describe the worker.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: The soldier is distinguished by the evenly rounded lateral margins of the labrum without lateral angles (C. snyderi has distinct but not sharp lateral angles); the left mandible is 0.67—0.76 mm long from the notch. The alate has a more vertical ocellar surface, but not as vertical as in C. snyderi, and more of the white area is visible from above.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head and pronotum dark brown, pronotum with a pale T-shaped mark; clypeus and tergites yellowish brown; sternites paler than the tergites; wings transparent, only the anterior margin and radius yellowish brown; femora and tibiae yellowish brown. Frontal gland large, white, depressed, about as large as the antennal sockets or slightly smaller. Eyes proportionally large, separated from the lower margin of the head by about 1/4 of their diameter. Ocelli rather large, separated from the eyes by about or slightly less than their long diameter, their surface rather vertical but not as vertical as in C. snyderi (in which less of the white area is visible from above). Antennae 15-segmented, segment 2 as long as segment 3, segment 4 slightly shorter than segment 3. Postclypeus twice as wide as long. Sides of the pronotum slightly narrowed posteriorly; posterior margin not concave or very weakly concave.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head and pronotum pale yellow. Head and pronotum with a few scattered setae, without short hairs; postmentum bare, with only about 2 setae at the front; tergites with setae; sternites with hairs and setae. Head small, sides curved, only slightly narrowed anteriorly; posterior margin evenly curved; middle of the head thick; lateral profile of the postmentum curved. Frontal tube proportionally rather large, covering the base of the postclypeus from above, level with or slightly upturned above the head surface. Narrowest part of the postmentum about 2/3 of the greatest width, the middle of the sides rather straight and parallel. Antennae 15-segmented. Sclerotized part of the labrum evenly rounded on both sides behind the base of the white median lobe. Anterior margin of the pronotum distinctly or slightly concave. Measurements (mm; original Table 16, given separately for the localities, means in parentheses; Lago Rogagua is the type locality): head length including mandibles 3.17—3.66 (3.45, n=8) / Cachuela Esperanza 3.17—3.41 (3.25, n=4); head length to the tip of the frontal tube 2.06—2.32 (2.21, n=10) / 2.09—2.29 (2.20, n=10); head width 1.78—2.12 (1.97) / 1.94—2.05 (1.98); head thickness 1.41—1.59 (1.52) / 1.35—1.50 (1.44); frontal tube length 0.35—0.41 (0.36) / 0.39—0.47 (0.42); labrum width 0.58—0.65 (0.61) / 0.54—0.60 (0.59); left mandible length 1.29—1.39 (1.34) / 1.26—1.35 (1.31); right mandible length from the notch 0.67—0.75 (0.72) / 0.71—0.76 (0.74); pronotum length 0.55—0.66 (0.61) / 0.58—0.65 (0.63); pronotum width 0.90—1.03 (0.97) / 0.94—1.04 (0.99); hind tibia length 1.76—1.94 (1.84) / 1.59—1.76 (1.69).
